section: 5/6/2026Enacted by Chapter 373, 2026 General Session2026Definitions.As used in this chapter:"Delivered value" means the fair market value of energy delivered for use and includes:the value of the energy itself; andany transportation, freight, customer demand charges, services charges, or other costs typically incurred in providing energy in usable form."Energy" means gas and electricity."Energy supplier" means a person supplying energy."High-impact consumer" means:a large load customer; ora qualifying data center."Large load customer" means the same as that term is defined in Section 54-26-101."Qualifying data center" means the same as that term is defined in Section 59-12-102."Regional economic development authority" means:the Military Installation Development Authority created in Section 63H-1-201;the Point of the Mountain State Land Authority created in Section 11-59-201; andthe Utah Fairpark Area Investment and Restoration District created in Section 11-70-201.
